The ten integrity tests cover changed bytes, missing files, unexpected files, duplicate records, unsafe
paths, symlinks, prohibited font files, and positive and empty-manifest cases. The distribution mani-
fest describes the actual 836-file preserved tree. It does not require the 73 excluded font files listed in
an older manifest. The exact earlier unsaved fixture-control failure was not recovered, so the record
makes no claim to reproduce that absent script. The replacement controls directly exercise the recov-
ered checker’s actual typed records and have their own fingerprints and receipts.

The finite computations were executed separately from Lean. Their domains overlap, so the following
rows are not added into one total. They support the implementations and worked examples. Universal
statements rely on proof terms under their declared hypotheses.

Exact algebra
1,008 exact rational assertions
Visual examples
147 symbolic, finite, and enclosure checks
Original tables
981 of 981 rows checked
Strengthened-paper suite
1,246 of 1,246 checks passed
Original-paper suite
647 of 647 checks passed
Rational subset and brackets
818 rational table rows and four bracket
records

The previously documented weakness of the strengthened numerical suite remains relevant: its his-
torical acceptance of mutations limits what its passing total can establish. It does not replace the formal
contract or the targeted compiler controls.

The recorded computation environment was Python 3.13.5, SymPy 1.14.0, mpmath 1.3.0, NumPy
2.3.5, pandas 2.2.3, and Matplotlib 3.10.8. These versions were detected during execution. All 836 files
in the preserved baseline remained byte-identical before and after the finite replay. Results and logs
were written separately.
